name: fp8-ada-mma-k32
what: Model replay of GemmAccumulator<K> (K a multiple of 32): tc_dot32_0, then (K/32 - 1) x tc_dot32 chained in ascending k; no cast at K=32 on ada_e4m3_m16n8k32: the FP32 accumulator word after every tc_dot32 step, from a zero accumulator.  Produced by verity.ml.tc.models.GroupSum.step on the laptop (silicon-p0, 2026-09-22) -- NOT a hardware capture; the instruction's pin is the model's evidence (verity.ml.tc.instructions.INSTRUCTIONS[instruction].evidence).

generator.recipe: random.Random(seed): per operand byte u = rng.random(); u < 0.10 -> +-0 (0x00/0x80); u < 0.25 -> a subnormal (exponent field 0, fraction 1..7, random sign); u < 0.30 -> +-448 (0x7E/0xFE); else a uniformly random finite byte (any of the 254 bytes other than 0x7F/0xFF); the accumulator starts at +0.0 (0x00000000)

operand_format: e4m3 bytes as 0x.. strings; a[k] and b[k] pair by index, ascending k
